name: Narmada Agrobase Limited
summary: Narmada Agrobase Limited produces and sells cotton seeds and cattle feeds in India, including cotton seed meal, linters, maize meal, oil cakes, poultry feed and delinted cotton seeds. These serve fertilizer, animal feed, furniture, paper and yarn uses, are marketed as Churma and Gaay Chhaap Narmada Pashu Aahar, and are partly exported. Incorporated in 2013, it is based in Ahmedabad.
